result.summary: 本文研究如何以最简单的方法实现测试时扩展（test-time scaling）并取得强推理性能 [S1.p1]。作者构建了仅含 1,000 个问题及其推理轨迹的数据集 s1K，并提出 budget forcing 这一测试时干预手段来控制思考 token 数量 [S1.p2]。在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上微调得到 s1-32B 后，该模型在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%，并可将 AIME24 成绩从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。作者开源了模型、数据和代码 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展与强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。其动机在于测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证有效，但已有复现依赖大规模强化学习或海量样本 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
the viability of this paradigm was recently validated by OpenAI o1
none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior

method.text: 方法包含两部分：一是数据构建，从 16 个来源收集 59,029 个问题，按质量、难度、多样性三条准则筛选出 1,000 个样本构成 s1K，推理轨迹由 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏生成 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。二是测试时扩展方法 budget forcing：若生成超过上限则强制插入思考结束符提前退出，若希望增加计算则抑制结束符并追加“Wait”以鼓励模型反思 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者将测试时扩展方法分为顺序式与并行式，并聚焦顺序式 [S3.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We collect an initial 59,029 questions from 16 sources following three guiding principles.
we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples
we generate a reasoning trace and solution using the Google Gemini Flash Thinking API
we enforce a maximum token count by simply appending the end-of-thinking token delimiter
we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and optionally append the string “Wait”
We focus on sequential scaling as intuitively we believe it should scale better

experiments.text: 训练方面，作者在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上用 s1K 做监督微调得到 s1-32B，在 16 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上训练 26 分钟 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。评估使用三个基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），默认温度 0 贪心解码，测准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。对比模型包括 OpenAI o1 系列、DeepSeek r1 系列、QwQ-32B-preview、Sky-T1-32B-Preview、Bespoke-32B 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。消融实验覆盖数据选择（随机、仅多样性、仅最长、全量 59K）与测试时扩展方法（token/step/class 条件控制、拒绝采样）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We perform supervised finetuning on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using s1K to obtain our model s1-32B
Finetuning took 26 minutes on 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with PyTorch FSDP.
We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
MATH500 is a benchmark of competition math problems of varying difficulty.
GPQA Diamond consists of 198 PhD-level science questions from Biology, Chemistry and Physics.
we evaluate with a temperature of 0 (greedy) and measure accuracy
We benchmark s1-32B against: OpenAI o1 series
Only Quality (1K-random): After obtaining our high-quality reasoning chains from Gemini, we select 1,000 samples at random
In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.

findings.text: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]，并且是样本效率最高的开源数据推理模型，仅用 1,000 个样本就显著优于基座模型 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。budget forcing 使 AIME24 成绩随测试时计算增加而提升，但最终在六倍处趋于平坦 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]，并可将 AIME24 从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。数据消融显示，随机选择、仅选最长或仅选最多样样本的性能都明显更差（AIME24 平均约低 30%），而全量 59K 相比 1K 并无实质增益 [S1.p3]。在测试时扩展方法比较中，budget forcing 具有完美可控性、良好扩展斜率和最佳 AIME24 成绩 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
We find that s1-32B is the most sample-efficient open data reasoning model.
It performs significantly better than our base model (Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct) despite just training it on an additional 1,000 samples.
it does eventually flatten out at six times
from 50% to 57% on AIME24
Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection.
we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score

limitations.text: 作者明确承认 budget forcing 在进一步扩展测试时计算时有两个关键局限：性能最终会趋于平坦，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口的限制 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。此外，作者指出能否仅用 1,000 个样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples.
